---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for FlowFi
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? What use case does it address?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Component
- [ ] Frontend
- [ ] Backend
- [ ] Smart Contracts
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other (please specify)

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Implementation Notes
If you have technical ideas about how this could be implemented, please share them here.

## Scope & Ownership
Describe the boundaries of this work and what is explicitly out of scope. If this is substantial work, note the intended owner and any dependent tasks that should be split into tracked sub-issues (see CONTRIBUTING.md → Advanced Task Ownership and Review Workflow).

## Test Expectations
What automated coverage should accompany this change? List the relevant success, failure, and boundary cases.

## Documentation Expectations
Which docs (API, contract, operational, or contributor) must be updated alongside this change?

## Reviewer Expectations
Who should review this (e.g. design review, security review, financial-accounting review)? Note any early design review needed before implementation.

## Evidence Requirements
For financial or security-sensitive changes, list the evidence to attach: test results, audit notes, and invariant checks.
